    ROUND(100.0 * (d.A13 - d.A12) / NULLIF(d.A12, 0), 2) AS unemployment_rate_pct_change
FROM main.district AS d

      SELECT a.district_id
      FROM main.loan AS l

      WHERE l.status = 'D'
  )
ORDER BY d.A2;
